_about: Public-domain Albert Barnes (1798-1870, pastor of First Presbyterian Church, Philadelphia) for the Word Hoard: Barnes' New Testament Notes clean from CCEL; and from raw Internet Archive OCR his Old Testament Notes on Job (1849), Isaiah (1847), Daniel (1853) and the Psalms (Harper), with An Inquiry into the Scriptural Views of Slavery (1846), Lectures on the Evidences of Christianity in the Nineteenth Century (1868), Miscellaneous Essays and Reviews (1855, 2 vols), A Manual of Prayer (1838), How Shall Man Be Just with God? (1854), An Inquiry into the Organization and Government of the Apostolic Church (1843) and Life at Threescore and Ten (1871). Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 10 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
